methods.name: create
methods.desc: Post the contest terms. They cannot change afterwards (no update method exists).

methods.name: opt_in_asset
methods.desc: Organizer funds the app's minimum balance and the app opts into the entry asset.

methods.name: join
methods.desc: Enter: grouped SITS (entry asset) transfer to the app plus a payment covering the entrant box.

methods.name: lock
methods.desc: Close entry and start the contest. Needs the minimum field.

methods.name: settle
methods.desc: Referee posts the result (signed by the referee account) and opens the challenge window.

methods.name: challenge
methods.desc:
v1 challenge: any entrant can flag the result inside the window. Payout pauses;
review is off-chain and disclosed as centralized. The organizer or referee then cancels (refunds) or the settle deadline passes and anyone can cancel.

methods.name: payout
methods.desc:
Anyone may trigger payout once the window has passed with no challenge.
All transfers are inner transactions in this one call: all succeed or none do.

methods.name: cancel
methods.desc:
Cancel and allow refunds.
- organizer or referee: any time before payout - anyone: OPEN past the join deadline with a short field, or not paid by the settle deadline

methods.name: refund
methods.desc: Return one entrant's entry after a cancel. Anyone may call; funds only go to the entrant.
